task.title: Make package audit discover skill assets from pi.skills
task.summary: Patch the package audit to inspect package-declared Pi skill assets instead of requiring CodeWiki-specific skills/codewiki paths.

goal.outcome: Package audit is package-neutral for Pi skills and no longer emits CodeWiki skill false positives against packages such as ThinkCode.
